about: The apps whose MCP servers this plugin starts. Each app keeps its own tools; bin/launch.mjs finds its checkout, builds it if needed, and runs its server. See docs/CAPABILITIES.md for what each one owns.

nexplan.role: Experiment planning at the SNS: structures, reflections, instruments, coverage, resolution, Bragg nodes on a volume grid, GSAS-II instrument parameters

materia.role: Structure refinement: CIF and data parsing, Rietveld and PDF/mPDF fitting, magnetic structures, symmetry modes, FullProf/GSAS-II export

nexus-viewer.role: Reduced 3-D volumes: open, symmetry averaging, artifact masks, slices, line cuts, I(Q), values at Bragg nodes, export for NEBULA3D

nebula3d.role: 3D-ΔPDF pipeline: ring removal, Bragg punch, backfill, flatten, ΔPDF, consistency check, stage diagnostics
nebula3d.plan: A FastMCP server in src/nebula3d/mcp.py over run_pipeline, the volume and ΔPDF slices, the consistency check and the Bragg profile; the in-browser NEBULA Pilot metrics stay in the web app.

rmc-workbench.role: RMCProfile runs: S(Q)/F(Q)/G(r) conversions and Auto StoG scaling, convergence, partial g(r) peaks, bond angles, displacement PCA
rmc-workbench.plan: A FastMCP server in rmc_toolkits/mcp.py over the scaling, transforms, triplets, KDE and PCA engines the Flask backend already calls.
